credit_unit: One public Context.next_credit driver invocation, debited before calling idle_wait, across the entire initialized Context. No refill/reset across callbacks/epochs/reconnect/spin/Future waits.
pacing_calls_counter: Diagnostic only; no independent finite limit.
watchdog_authority: Actual admitted public producer owns the whole VM invocation, including startup/ROS callbacks/IPC/logging/drain/retirement. This deployment timeout is a failure ceiling, not a sleep, normal-window duration or permission. Actual native/collector lifecycle contract must cover its selected full stages.
budget_derivation: Public deployment.prepare allows at most300s per invocation; selected ceil(300s / unchanged1ms) + 1 =300001 driver invocations covers its one complete lifetime, including full source warmup+120normal+stop. Actual early wakes, IPC, phase duration and native ingress require source-bound authentication and measurement. Count is not proof of elapsed time or an unconditional native-event upper bound.
failure: Public preallocated SchedulingBudgetExhausted propagates; original main finally/owner cleanup runs. Exhaustion never means task completion or ROS cancellation.
normal_return: Only actual independent canonical Booltrue and successful cancel-owner close sets pacing.stopped; original-return without receipt raises. DriverFalse alone is not native robot stop or Context shutdown.
normal_120_seconds: Complete new long scenario source has a240s failure window and fits this300s per-invocation ceiling without shortening any phase. Require complete actual source warmup plus >=120s normal physical feedback and subsequent stop/cancel/retirement under exact admitted scene. A120s score does not bound total invocation.
capacity: r42/r43 240s conditional planning reports remain historical. These conditional240s reservations must be recomputed for the selected complete300s failure envelope before launch. Recompute/admit exact selected actor full-stage source/native/collector count/row/file budgets before robot execution. No count/file/payload clipping or suppressed evidence accepted.
